_comment: Isolated close-tier reproduction #3 for #1616, drill mode, no combat. Places a 30-wide single-rank Cavalry block (frontage_override 30, so Unit._pivot_radius() -- and therefore Unit.terrain_clearance() = _pivot_radius() + soldier_body_radius() -- is huge, ~590wu) close enough to the default map's hill patch (Battle.TERRAIN rect (1150,380)-(1400,580), kind 'block' -- the only PathField block_rect on this map; the forest patch is kind 'slow', a speed zone that PathField never routes around) that PathField._segment_blocked's room-capped clearance-grown margin around the hill (room ~522wu, capped below the ~590wu clearance itself, growing the hill's x-range out to roughly [628,1922]) swallows the move-order destination (650,730) outright -- the unit's own spawn position (510,787) sits just outside that grown region (~118wu short in x) but the straight LEG between the two still crosses it, so PathField.next_step's funnel-corner computation still treats the direct march as spuriously 'blocked' even though neither point nor the direct line is anywhere near the drawn hill itself. Ordered via a plain rmb_click move (no enemy, no far tier) to isolate that funnel-corner computation as the mechanism, per the 'construct scenarios to isolate the phenomenon' rule. `state` samples: a complete tick-by-tick scan of the pre-fix code across this whole march (ticks 20-520) found the corner-selection instability surfaces as five distinct alternating episodes -- 82-83, 270-274, 332-354, 422-438, 498-520 -- separated by long flat stretches where the heavily-throttled pivot rate this wide a formation gets (see PathField.gd's own _funnel_corner comment) holds facing essentially constant. `state` is per-tick across each episode plus a margin of 5-15 ticks on both sides, and coarse (roughly every 20-40 ticks) in the confirmed-flat stretches between them and before/after -- this is a size-conscious substitute for per-tick across the whole clip (which a CI-posted transcript comment cannot afford at GitHub's 65536-character cap), not a coarser substitute for genuine per-tick sensitivity: every tick DemoDefects.facing_reversals could actually see a same-window flip on is still sampled.
